source.locator: 'CPUC TPR Public'!A4:CM497; headers row 3; 'TPR Notes'!B3:C5, B23:C23

geographicScope: SCE FERC-jurisdictional transmission capital portfolio, including reported work outside California; not all California transmission projects.
inventoryScope: Nonaggregate project/subproject lines except Operational and Canceled. On Hold and unknown lifecycle remain visible; includes ancillary capital work. Program aggregates are separately reconciled without inventing child projects.
limitations: Source edition lifecycle is not live status and never inferred from elapsed milestone dates.
Project Manager is not asset owner; personal manager data is omitted and owners remain unknown.
Published positions have no stated datum or positional accuracy; mapped centers remain unverified with explicit assumptions.
Multiple or ambiguous positions may be retained without a center. No route geometry is inferred.
Construction start and projected-or-actual in-service are distinct; no construction end or continuous interval is inferred.
Public download is available without login; no dataset-specific open reuse license was declared.
Native TPR IDs are preserved; repeated work orders are aliases, not deduplication keys.
